adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `destinationCalendar` to an array and updates GoogleCalendarService `createEvent(calEventRaw, credentialId)` to pick `calendarId` via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId`, falling back to "primary" when not found. In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, the branch for destinations with NULL/absent `credentialId` calls `await Promise.all(destinationCalendarCredentials.map(async (c) => await createEvent(c, event)))` (no `externalId` passed). As a result, `createEvent` returns `externalId` undefined and Google’s calendar selection cannot match by `credentialId`, so it will insert into "primary" instead of the intended `destination.externalId`. Downstream, `EventManager` now records `externalCalendarId: result.externalId`, which will be undefined for these calls, making later update/delete resolution likely fail. This is a concrete behavior change/regression for legacy DestinationCalendar rows lacking `credentialId`.
